purpose: PC-F semantic parity pin. Each case records what the LEGACY query surface answers over a donor world and what the Claim-native surface answers over the same world restated as Subjects and Claims. Rows are query MEANING -- selected values or result identity -- never wire receipts, paths, or provenance. While the donor island stands, tests/test_playbill/test_modeling_parity_donors.py re-derives every donor_rows entry from the legacy engine, so these are recordings and not guesses. After PC-F slice F8 purges the donors, tests/test_playbill/test_modeling_parity.py keeps asserting the Claim-native side against these same rows.
donor_archive_note: kits/ bundles were deleted in b36b2a1b. tests/data/config_donors/ holds the PC-F parity slices of kits/project-domain and kits/supply-chain-blast-radius at b36b2a1b^, alongside the agent-operation config copied in DP-0C.

cases.semantics: Collection entry over one Subject kind, membership filter on a single-valued property, five-field projection, explicit result budget.
Reverse one-hop traversal from a parameter-bound entry Subject, equality filter on the traversed Subject, ascending timestamp ordering.
Same traversal under a NEGATED membership filter and descending timestamp ordering -- the curated complement of the scratchpad read.
Unfiltered reverse traversal with entity/Subject result shape and entity/Subject dedupe -- the flat area work queue.
Business-domain reverse traversal with a negated membership filter on the traversed Subject and a five-field projection.
Two competing observations of one single-valued property. Spec v3 s10.3: single-valued projection selects by the accepted ClaimType policy or emits a typed conflict, and never picks last row wins.

divergence.donor: The property store holds one value per field, so the second write replaced the first. wi-1 silently left the active work queue and no read can recover that a disagreement existed.
divergence.playbill: Both Claims stand accepted. A refuse_on_conflict policy refuses with playbill.query.claim_conflict; a surface_conflicts policy returns the row with the field in the conflict state and names both competing statement digests.

cases.semantics: One declaration read at two instants. Spec v3 s10.2: every canonical query binds an accepted coordinate and an explicit evaluation time.

divergence.donor: execute_query takes no evaluation time and NamedQuerySchema declares no effective interval. A property is whatever the last write left there, read at an unstated now.
divergence.playbill: wi-3's status Claim carries effective_until. At the earlier instant the claim is supported and wi-3 is in the queue; at the declared evaluation time the same unmodified Claim is stale and the queue is shorter.

cases.semantics: Ordering an operational queue by a declared severity ordinal. Identical result SET, different sequence.

divergence.donor: order by the DECLARED ORDINAL of the incident_severity enum (low_to_high), descending: critical outranks medium.
divergence.playbill: QueryValueTypeV1 has no enum member, so the nearest declarable key is the severity string. Descending lexicographic UTF-8 puts medium above critical.

deferred_donor_features.expresses: Keep a traversal candidate only when a SEPARATE one-hop edge exists (or does not exist) off that candidate, optionally constrained on the related edge and on both of its endpoints, with the outer entry/current/candidate scopes still bound so the check can join back to the query entry. Existential: the related Subject is never returned.
deferred_donor_features.playbill_equivalent: The semi-join is a second required traversal step plus Subject dedupe (parity.agent_operation.notes_on_open_review reproduces donor_semi_join_rows exactly). The bare anti-join is a negated Claim-presence filter, because a relation edge IS a Claim on the source Subject (parity.agent_operation.notes_without_review reproduces donor_anti_join_rows exactly).
deferred_donor_features.residual_gap: An anti-join CONSTRAINED ON THE FAR ENDPOINT -- 'notes with no edge to a review that is approved'. Claim presence never reaches the related Subject's own Claims, and there is no negated traversal step. The semi-join also costs a binding and forces dedupe, so the row shape is wider than the donor's.
deferred_donor_features.loss_if_dropped: Both common forms survive the purge with no new grammar. The uncovered form is the narrow one: negative existence qualified by the related Subject's state.

deferred_donor_features.expresses: A string mini-language comparing one traversal candidate property against a query parameter or literal: 'target.<property> <op> $<param>', with ==, !=, >, >=, <, <=, before, on_or_before, after, on_or_after.
deferred_donor_features.playbill_equivalent: QueryComparisonFilterV1(left=QueryClaimValueRefV1(...), operator='eq', right=QueryParameterRefV1(...), value_type='string') on the traversal step's where. Typed at declaration instead of guessed at run time, and unparseable input refuses instead of silently passing every candidate.
deferred_donor_features.residual_gap: None for the query grammar. The donor form parses target. only; source. raises, and an unparseable rule returns True and filters nothing.
deferred_donor_features.loss_if_dropped: Nothing. The behavior is already ported and the ported form is stricter.

deferred_donor_features.expresses: A STANDING whole-graph invariant with a severity: 'REL.FROM.<property> <op> REL.TO.<property>'. Every stored edge of that relationship is checked and each breach becomes a finding. It filters no query row.
deferred_donor_features.playbill_equivalent: The per-edge value comparison itself is declarable -- a comparison filter whose two sides are QueryClaimValueRefV1 on two different bindings. What has no query form is the standing part: a named invariant, a severity, and a findings report produced without anyone running a query.
deferred_donor_features.residual_gap: The invariant role. In Playbill that belongs to ClaimType admission and resolution policy and to the acceptance laws, not to a canonical read.
deferred_donor_features.loss_if_dropped: No query capability. The invariant capability must be shown to already live in ClaimAdmissionPolicy/ClaimResolutionPolicy before this is called a clean drop.

deferred_donor_features.expresses: Order by an enum member's DECLARED position in an ordered config enum, so critical outranks high outranks medium outranks low.
deferred_donor_features.playbill_equivalent: None. QueryValueTypeV1 is string, integer, boolean, decimal, timestamp, subject_reference. Ordering a severity or priority falls back to lexicographic string order, which is wrong and silently so.
deferred_donor_features.residual_gap: Every ordered enum in every domain: priority, severity, criticality, lifecycle rank.
deferred_donor_features.loss_if_dropped: Priority and severity queues are the most-run operational read in all three donor domains and they come out in the wrong order. See case sc.open_incidents_by_severity for the pinned evidence.

deferred_donor_features.donor_symbol: cruxible_core.config.compact select counts:/items:, lowered to QueryIncludeSpec plus $include.<name>.count
deferred_donor_features.expresses: A per-row cardinality over an adjacent relationship without returning the adjacent rows: how many notes, how many blockers, how many dependents.
deferred_donor_features.playbill_equivalent: QueryIncludeV1 returns a bounded item list under a required max_items, and the result reports whether the include truncated. There is no aggregate value reference and no unbounded count.
deferred_donor_features.residual_gap: A true cardinality. An include capped at max_items cannot say 'and there are 4,000 more' with a number.
deferred_donor_features.loss_if_dropped: Rollup reads lose their headline number. Callers must page every adjacent row to count it, which is exactly the row-by-row expansion the compact-card SLO exists to avoid.

deferred_donor_features.expresses: Case-sensitive and case-folded substring containment on a string property.
deferred_donor_features.playbill_equivalent: None inside the canonical query grammar: QueryComparisonOperatorV1 is eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, and membership is exact. Section 11 exact/lexical discovery is where inexact matching lives, and it deliberately never resolves equivalence.
deferred_donor_features.residual_gap: Substring filtering inside a governed canonical read.
deferred_donor_features.loss_if_dropped: Free-text narrowing of a canonical query. The discovery layer already covers find-by-name, and an unindexable substring scan inside a budgeted canonical read is the thing the budgets exist to prevent.

deferred_donor_features.expresses: One declared step that walks a UNION of several relationship types and repeats itself up to a declared depth -- reachability, not a fixed shape.
deferred_donor_features.playbill_equivalent: A QueryTraversalStepV1 names exactly one predicate, one direction, one hop. Depth is a BUDGET (max_traversal_depth) that bounds the declared steps; it never repeats one. A fixed-depth union can be unrolled into steps and any_of filters, but the row shape multiplies and unbounded reachability cannot be declared at all.
deferred_donor_features.residual_gap: Transitive closure: descendants, lineage, upstream dependency chains.
deferred_donor_features.loss_if_dropped: agent-operation's work_item_rollup_context and work_item_lineage_context and project-domain's area_work_items are all reachability reads. Losing them costs the caller a hand-rolled loop over repeated single-hop queries with no budget accounting.
